persistent-boot.note: The RAM bootstrap must be loaded over USB for every Linux boot.

local-console.note: 240×320 graphical terminal with phone-keypad input; RTC wake preserves the shell in USB-powered RAM sessions. Operation without USB power is untested.

lcd-backlight.note: System scale 0…10, raw range 0…20; visible spacing of the new intermediate levels is not fully verified.

keypad-backlight.note: Binary LED control plus a bounded key-press light.

file-transfer.note: RAM and a writable mounted microSD are valid destinations.

manual-cpu-frequency-selection.note: Switching between 768 MHz and 1 GHz works on this phone.

ap-dmaengine.note: ROTA uses its fixed peripheral request; see platform limits.

image-rotation-engine.note: Hardware rotation through V4L2 mem2mem, including RGB, grayscale and two-plane YUV.

jpeg-engine.note: Baseline JPEG decode, fixed JPEG encode geometries, and two fixed half-size NV16 scaler pairs.

native-image-output.note: Native 240×320 NV16 or CPU-converted RGB565 presentation through LCDC. Returns to the same terminal and shell; visible image fidelity is untested.

image-rotation.note: Included in the normal root filesystem; explicit CPU/ROTA selection and DRM preview. Returns to the same terminal and shell; visible image fidelity is untested.

jpeg-codec-and-scaling.note: Included in the normal root filesystem; hardware decode, fixed encode, and fixed half-scaling.

native-image-presentation.note: Included in the normal root filesystem; direct NV16 or CPU-converted RGB565 presentation. Returns to the same terminal and shell; visible image fidelity is untested.

removable-storage.note: FAT32 and ext4 read/write; unmounted hot-swap is available.

removable-system-root.note: microSD FAT32 FIT plus writable ext4; the system card stays installed.

internal-phone-storage.note: Read-only raw NAND backup; no filesystem, writes or restore.

headphone-audio.note: Stereo S16_LE playback with volume levels, equalizer and automatic level control from this phone's saved audio profile.

speaker-audio.note: One speaker above the display, alone or with headphones. Volume levels, equalizer and automatic level control come from this phone's saved audio profile.

phone-microphone.note: Built-in and original wired-headset microphones; 48-kHz mono capture can run alongside 48-kHz stereo playback.

fm-radio.note: RAM profile: scan and headphone/speaker playback with EQ/ALC off. EQ-on playback checked on headphones only; speaker EQ and microSD FM not tested.

bluetooth.note: BR/EDR pairing, bidirectional OPP and PAN Internet in both profiles; LE keyboards and mice in the RAM profile; requires firmware from this phone.

wi-fi.stockNote: Stock Wi-Fi connectivity is unavailable; physical radio presence remains unknown.

camera.note: Rear GC2145; 800×600 and 1600×1200 NV16 through V4L2 in the RAM profile. Camera with a microSD system root is unverified. Sensor rotation is 270° counterclockwise; capture leaves pixels unchanged. Hardware JPEG accepts 1600×1200, but not 800×600. At 800×600, capture and JPEG queues may stay enabled and take turns; codec jobs need their own supported geometry. Capture continues through display updates, blanking and wake. Stop capture before hardware rotation.

battery-telemetry.note: Voltage, signed current and a relative charge counter; absolute accuracy is unchecked.

soc-temperature.note: Calibrated reading without external accuracy validation.

auxiliary-adc.note: Five raw channels without physical-unit conversion.

real-time-clock.note: Read/set time, one-shot alarms and RTC wake in both profiles, including after time correction; no update interrupts or alarm power-on.

other-battery-functions.note: No level, battery temperature or charge control is provided.

vibration.note: Binary FF_RUMBLE effects with a five-second automatic cutoff.

power-off.note: Hold the red handset key for five seconds; external charger power must be absent.

suspend.note: s2idle in both profiles, including Bluetooth, mounted data cards and card-backed swap; the red handset key and RTC alarms are wake sources.

fplinux-armada.note: Synchronizes the display, keypad light and vibrator.

brightness-control.note: Phone-keypad control of levels 0…10; level 0 turns the backlight off.

tyrquake.note: Game data can use the supported microSD path.

built-in-microphone.note: Mono 48-kHz capture can run alongside 48-kHz stereo playback.

headset-microphone.note: Original wired headset; select the Headset source before recording.

automatic-audio-routing.note: Insert/remove selects the playback output in USB-powered RAM sessions; switching a playing signal can click.

bluetooth-pairing.note: BR/EDR pairing in RAM and microSD profiles.

bluetooth-file-transfer.note: Bidirectional OPP in RAM and microSD profiles.

bluetooth-pan-internet.note: PAN Internet in RAM and microSD profiles.

bluetooth-a2dp-linux-pc.note: A2DP audio has not been tested on this phone.

bluetooth-a2dp-headsets.note: Physical Bluetooth headsets have not been tested.

bluetooth-keyboard.note: LE input in the RAM profile; Classic input is untested.

bluetooth-mouse.note: LE input in the RAM profile; Classic input is untested.

mobile-calls.note: Calls are not supported in FPLinux.

sms.note: SMS is not supported in FPLinux.

mobile-data.note: Mobile data is not supported in FPLinux.

ffmpeg.note: Optional CPU MPEG-4 Part 2, H.263 and H.264 decoding; device use is untested.

microsd-hot-swap.stockNote: The normal stock installation procedure powers the phone off; powered replacement is unconfirmed.
microsd-hot-swap.note: Unmount a data card before removal or insertion while Linux runs. A microSD system card must stay installed.

sim-hot-swap.stockNote: The normal stock installation procedure powers the phone off; powered replacement is unconfirmed.
sim-hot-swap.note: FPLinux does not support cellular service or SIM cards.

infrared-transmitter.note: FPLinux provides no infrared remote-control path.

gpu-rendering.note: No FPLinux GPU rendering path on this phone.
